name: n8n-code-javascript
description: Expert JavaScript for n8n Code nodes, `$input/$json/$node`, `$helpers.httpRequest()`, DateTime, and Code-node troubleshooting.

Choose "Run Once for All Items" mode (recommended for most use cases); use `$input.all()`, `$input.first()`, or `$input.item`. **CRITICAL**: Must return `[{json: {...}}]` format. Webhook data is under `$json.body` (not `$json` directly). Built-ins: `$helpers.httpRequest()`, DateTime (Luxon), `$jmespath()`.

Use All Items for aggregation, filtering, batches, transformations, and API calls; Each Item only for independent per-item logic. Not sure? Use "All Items" mode.

Always return an array of objects with `json`; use optional chaining/guards. No n8n expressions—use JavaScript template literals. Prefer map/filter over manual loops; filter before expensive transformations. Do not use Code for simple mapping/filtering/conditionals/HTTP-only; use Set, Filter, IF/Switch, or HTTP Request nodes.

Before deploying: [ ] **Code is not empty** - Must have meaningful logic [ ] **Return statement exists** - Must return array of objects [ ] **Proper
